units.source_text: 他陪源氏公子饮酒，直到夜阑。

en.t: He kept Prince Genji company drinking wine until deep into the night.
That night the prince stayed there.

units.source_text: 旧日的侍女都来伺候，共谈往事。

en.t: The former serving women all came to attend him, and they talked together about old times.

units.source_text: 其中有一个叫作中纳言君的，向来暗中受公子宠爱，胜于别的侍女。

en.t: Among them was one called Lady Chunagon, who had long secretly enjoyed the prince's favor more than the other serving women.

units.source_text: 这一天此人口上虽然不便说出，而心中窃自悲叹。

en.t: On this day, though she could not very well say anything aloud, she grieved and sighed secretly in her heart.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看到她的模样，也在心中偷偷地可怜她。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw how she looked, he too secretly pitied her in his heart.

units.source_text: 夜色渐深，众人都睡静了，独留这中纳言君陪伴公子谈话。

en.t: As the night gradually deepened and everyone had fallen quietly asleep, only Lady Chunagon remained to keep the prince company and talk with him.

units.source_text: 他今晚留宿于此，大约是为此人吧。

en.t: His staying there tonight was probably for her sake.
